pending: Real hardware mid-gesture Escape, held-range cancellation, focus loss, interrupted crop and interrupted pen capture; source code handling does not replace device tests.
Touch, stylus pressure, multi-pointer and additional browser engines.
Large files, 300-stroke/100000-coordinate/200000-stamp capacity under actual hardware load, long-running performance and memory stability.
Full workflow under network isolation and browser download actual disk writes. Local files and PNG preview are verified separately.
Artistic quality evaluation or arbitrary semantic artist-style transfer, which the current parameter brush does not implement.
boundaries: Known local source IDs and visible normalized crop only; no arbitrary source reconstruction, object recognition, segmentation or invented texture.
C28 derives a five-color palette, brightness-gradient principal direction and finite brush filaments. It does not learn curved artistic brushstrokes or reproduce an artist's semantic style.
Target boundaries are explicit rectangles, not detected objects. Drawing overlays do not modify the original images or original base artwork file.

Two fixed layers on a1200x900 Canvas2D paper, up to300 total strokes/200 per layer,5000 points per stroke/100000 total points, and200000 effective stamp budget. The canonical saved document must stay within3MiB.
Each stroke stores its own source crop and brush parameters. Deterministic replay is verified in this browser session; cross-browser color/pixel equality and broad performance are not promised.

Zoom and pan are presentation state; persisted JSON restores original paper coordinates, sources, strokes, layer visibility and base. It does not persist an entire undo stack or temporary pointer movement.

At the end of validation, only this initially empty creative workspace is restored to a clean starting paper. The actual four-stroke example is preserved in a separate recoverable JSON and PNG. Other scene workspaces are not touched.
